turns.text: i called consent request init and only got 202 back with no body. where do i get the consent request id from

must_contain: The init call only returns 202 Accepted, and the consent request id arrives later on a callback to your HIU bridge.
That callback lands at /api/v3/hiu/consent/request/on-init, and consentRequest.id in it is the consent request id to store.
notes: A first-day HIU developer expects the id in the synchronous response; a wrong answer tells them to parse the 202 body. Distinct from faq-verbatim-sandbox-m3-07, which only says an id is returned, not where. Source lines: catalogue/hiecm/endpoints/m3-consent-request-init.md, 'The call returns 202 Accepted. The consent request id arrives on [consent request on-init]'; catalogue/hiecm/callbacks/m3-on-consent-request-init.md, 'ABDM answers on your [HIU] bridge at `/api/v3/hiu/consent/request/on-init`. `consentRequest.id` is the consent request id. Store it'.
